headline: Assassin's Creed 2: Ezio in Renaissance Italy
title: Assassins Creed 2 Facts | Ezio Auditore | Classic Games
video_script: Assassin's Creed two launched in November two thousand nine on PlayStation three and Xbox 360, from Ubisoft Montreal. You play Ezio Auditore, an assassin in Renaissance Italy from fourteen seventy six to fourteen ninety nine, hunting those who killed his father and brothers. Cities like Florence and Venice were recreated for the open world. The PC version followed in March twenty ten. Best Assassin's Creed game? Comment below!
description: Assassin's Creed II (Ubisoft Montreal, November 2009): Ezio Auditore in Renaissance Italy, with Florence and Venice recreated; PC version in March 2010. Source: Wikipedia.
